newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury sees 1.5 pct productivity.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury sees 1.5 pct productivity.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Monday the economy could sustain labour productivity growth of 1.25 to 1.5 a year.
In the August 20 budget papers the Treasury said it expected productivity growth to fall to its "structural" rate after rapid gains following the 1990-91 recession.
Asked in a parliamentary committee what that rate was, Evans said: "Something in the region of about 1 1/4, 1 1/2 percent."
Treasury did not estimate recent productivity growth rates in the budget.
